knowledge:
- key_parameters: density=Trims low-density margins of summarized regions in populationRanges (e.g., density=0.1 trims areas with <10% of calls) ;; mode=Summarization method in populationRanges ("RO" for reciprocal overlap, default is density-based) ;; ro.thresh=Reciprocal overlap threshold (e.g., 0.51 requires at least 51% mutual overlap between regions) ;; est.recur=Logical indicating whether to estimate GISTIC-like significance for recurrent CNVs in populationRanges ;; window=Genomic window size around CNV regions for eQTL testing in cnvEQTL (e.g., "1Mbp") ;; min.samples=Minimum number of samples required in a deviating copy number group to keep a CNV region in cnvEQTL ;; produce.gds=Logical to prevent overwriting an existing GDS file in cnvGWAS ;; run.lrr=Logical to run GWAS using relative signal intensities (LRR) instead of integer copy number states in cnvGWAS
- alternatives: EnsembleCNV=Use for combining CNV calls from multiple SNP-based callers ;; FusorSV=Use for combining CNV calls from multiple sequencing-based callers ;; ABSOLUTE=Use for accurately calculating absolute integer copy numbers in cancer by accounting for tumor purity and ploidy ;; PureCN=Use for accurately calculating absolute integer copy numbers in cancer by accounting for tumor purity and ploidy
- when_to_use: Use when you have pre-filtered, quality-controlled CNV calls with integer copy number states from a diploid species and want to perform population-level summarization, functional genomic overlap testing, RNA-seq eQTL association, or probe/segment-level quantitative phenotype GWAS.
- pitfalls: Only applicable to diploid species ;; Does not perform CNV calling or quality control (input calls must be pre-filtered) ;; Read-depth CNV calls must exclude repetitive/low-complexity regions beforehand to avoid false recurrent regions in GISTIC-like summarization ;; Rough conversion of log2 copy ratios to integer states (round((2^lr)*2)) ignores tumor purity, ploidy, and subclonality in cancer ;; GWAS chromosome names must be integer-encoded (non-integer names require a mapping data frame)

workflows.name: cnv_population_summarization_and_overlap
workflows.intent: Summarize individual CNV calls across a population and assess their overlap with functional genomic regions using permutation tests.
input: Silva16_PONE_CNV_calls.csv (CSV file containing CNV calls with columns: chr, start, end, sample ID, and integer copy number state)
EnsDb (Ensembl database object containing gene annotations)
workflows.stages: 1. Read CNV calls and represent them as a GRangesList; 2. Summarize individual calls into population-level CNV regions using density trimming or reciprocal overlap; 3. Identify recurrent CNV regions; 4. Find overlaps between CNV regions and functional genomic regions (genes); 5. Perform an overlap permutation test to assess statistical significance.
workflows.code:
data.dir <- system.file("extdata", package="CNVRanger")
call.file <- file.path(data.dir, "Silva16_PONE_CNV_calls.csv")
calls <- read.csv(call.file, as.is=TRUE)
grl <- GenomicRanges::makeGRangesListFromDataFrame(calls, split.field="NE_id", keep.extra.columns=TRUE)
grl <- GenomicRanges::sort(grl)
cnvrs <- populationRanges(grl, density=0.1)
ro.cnvrs <- populationRanges(grl[1:100], mode="RO", ro.thresh=0.51)
cnvrs <- populationRanges(grl, density=0.1, est.recur=TRUE)
subset(cnvrs, pvalue < 0.05)
plotRecurrentRegions(cnvrs, genome="bosTau6", chr="chr1")
olaps <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(sel.genes, sel.cnvrs, ignore.strand=TRUE)
qh <- S4Vectors::queryHits(olaps)
sh <- S4Vectors::subjectHits(olaps)
cgenes <- sel.genes[qh]
cgenes$type <- sel.cnvrs$type[sh]
cnvOncoPrint(grl, cgenes)
res <- regioneR::overlapPermTest(A=sel.cnvrs, B=sel.genes, ntimes=100, genome="bosTau6", mask=NA, per.chromosome=TRUE, count.once=TRUE)
summary(res[[1]]$permuted)
plot(res)

workflows.name: cnv_expression_eqtl_association
workflows.intent: Perform association testing between CNV regions and RNA-seq expression levels to identify dosage and neighborhood effects.
input: counts_cleaned.txt (Tab-delimited matrix of RNA-seq read counts)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare CNV calls as a GRangesList and summarize them into population-level CNV regions; 2. Prepare RNA-seq counts as a RangedSummarizedExperiment; 3. Run cnvEQTL to test for expression differences across copy number states; 4. Plot eQTL results.
workflows.code:
rseq.file <- file.path(data.dir, "counts_cleaned.txt")
rcounts <- read.delim(rseq.file, row.names=1, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
rcounts <- as.matrix(rcounts)
rranges <- GenomicRanges::granges(sel.genes)[rownames(rcounts)]
rse <- SummarizedExperiment(assays=list(rcounts=rcounts), rowRanges=rranges)
res <- cnvEQTL(cnvrs, grl, rse, window = "1Mbp", verbose = TRUE)
res

workflows.name: cnv_expression_eqtl_tcga
workflows.intent: Perform integrated CNV-expression association analysis using TCGA data stored in a MultiAssayExperiment.
input: MultiAssayExperiment (Object containing GISTIC peaks, CNV SNP calls, and RNA-seq expression data)
workflows.stages: 1. Harmonize genomic coordinates and filter assays to intersecting samples; 2. Convert segmented log2 copy number ratios to integer copy number states; 3. Run cnvEQTL on the MultiAssayExperiment; 4. Plot eQTL results.
workflows.code:
gbm <- curatedTCGAData::curatedTCGAData("GBM", assays=c("GISTIC_Peaks", "CNVSNP", "RNASeq2GeneNorm"), version = "1.1.38", dry.run=FALSE)
gbm <- TCGAutils::symbolsToRanges(gbm, unmapped=FALSE)
for(i in 1:3) 
{
    rr <- rowRanges(gbm[[i]])
    GenomeInfoDb::genome(rr) <- "NCBI37"
    GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(rr) <- "UCSC"
    ind <- as.character(seqnames(rr)) %in% c("chr1", "chr2")
    rowRanges(gbm[[i]]) <- rr
    gbm[[i]] <- gbm[[i]][ind,]
}
gbm <- MultiAssayExperiment::intersectColumns(gbm)
gbm <- TCGAutils::TCGAsplitAssays(gbm, sampleCodes="01")
ind <- grep("CNVSNP", names(gbm))
smean <- mcols(gbm[[ind]])$Segment_Mean
state <- round(2^smean * 2)
state[state > 4] <- 4
mcols(gbm[[ind]])$state <- state
gbm[[ind]] <- gbm[[ind]][state != 2,]
mcols(gbm[[ind]]) <- mcols(gbm[[ind]])[,3:1]
res <- cnvEQTL(cnvrs="01_GBM_GISTIC_Peaks-20160128", calls="01_GBM_CNVSNP-20160128", rcounts="01_GBM_RNASeq2GeneNorm-20160128_ranged", data=gbm, window="1Mbp", verbose=TRUE)
res
(r <- GRanges(names(res)[2]))
plotEQTL(cnvr=r, genes=res[[2]], genome="hg19", cn="CN1")

workflows.name: cnv_phenotype_gwas
workflows.intent: Run a probe-level or segment-level genome-wide association study (GWAS) linking CNVs to quantitative phenotypes.
input: CNVOut.txt (Tab-delimited file containing CNV calls with optional probe information)
Pheno.txt (Tab-delimited file containing sample ID, family ID, sex, and quantitative phenotype)
MapPenn.txt (Optional tab-delimited file containing probe IDs and genomic coordinates)
workflows.stages: 1. Read CNV calls and represent them as a GRangesList; 2. Combine CNV calls and phenotype data into a RaggedExperiment; 3. Set up the GWAS directory and files using setupCnvGWAS; 4. Define chromosome mapping for non-integer chromosome names; 5. Run cnvGWAS to identify significant CNV segments; 6. Plot results using plotManhattan; 7. Optionally generate a GDS file or run GWAS using relative signal intensities (LRR).
workflows.code:
cnv.loc <- file.path(data.dir, "CNVOut.txt") 
cnv.calls <- read.delim(cnv.loc, as.is=TRUE) 
cnv.calls <- GenomicRanges::makeGRangesListFromDataFrame(cnv.calls, split.field="sample.id", keep.extra.columns=TRUE)
phen.loc <- file.path(data.dir, "Pheno.txt")
colData <- read.delim(phen.loc, as.is=TRUE)
mcols(cnv.calls) <- colData
re <- RaggedExperiment::RaggedExperiment(cnv.calls)
map.loc <- file.path(data.dir, "MapPenn.txt")
phen.info <- setupCnvGWAS("example", cnv.out.loc=re, map.loc=map.loc)
all.paths <- phen.info$all.paths
chr.code.name <- data.frame(V1 = c(16, 25, 29:31), V2 = c("1A", "4A", "25LG1", "25LG2", "LGE22"))
segs.pvalue.gr <- cnvGWAS(phen.info, chr.code.name=chr.code.name, method.m.test="none")
order.chrs <- c(1:24, "25LG1", "25LG2", 27:28, "LGE22", "1A", "4A")
chr.size.file <- file.path(data.dir, "Parus_major_chr_sizes.txt")
chr.sizes <- scan(chr.size.file)
chr.size.order <- data.frame(chr=order.chrs, sizes=chr.sizes, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
plotManhattan(all.paths, segs.pvalue.gr, chr.size.order, plot.pdf=FALSE)
probes.cnv.gr <- generateGDS(phen.info, chr.code.name=chr.code.name)
segs.pvalue.gr <- cnvGWAS(phen.info, chr.code.name=chr.code.name, produce.gds=FALSE)
files <- list.files(data.dir, pattern = "\\.cnv.txt.adjusted$")
samples <- sub(".cnv.txt.adjusted$", "", files)
samples <- sub("^GT","", samples)
sample.files <- data.frame(file.names=files, sample.names=samples)
importLrrBaf(all.paths, data.dir, sample.files, verbose=FALSE)
cnv.gds <- file.path(all.paths[1], "CNV.gds")
genofile <- SNPRelate::snpgdsOpen(cnv.gds, allow.fork=TRUE, readonly=FALSE)
gdsfmt::closefn.gds(genofile)
segs.pvalue.gr <- cnvGWAS(phen.info, chr.code.name=chr.code.name, produce.gds=FALSE, run.lrr=TRUE)
